links.outcome: Readability of AI patient education responses (FRES, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level)
links.effect: Both models showed similar readability (FRES P >.05; FKGL P >.05); authors conclude readability requires improvement.
links.quote: However, they require improvements in terms of adherence to scientific standards, transparency, citations, and readability.

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the quality, readability, and completeness of patient education responses generated by ChatGPT-4o and DeepSeek V3 for rotator cuff injuries without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
